podcast.body: Their former record label released a greatest hits album in 1999, prompting the band to reform and tour in support of it. "In 1999, their old record label released a greatest hits album, and asked if the band wouldn't mind reforming and touring behind it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
